# Locally bundled dependencies

No runtime CDN requests. Copy this folder with every installation.

- Skulpt 1.2.0: `skulpt/skulpt.min.js`, `skulpt/skulpt-stdlib.js`.
  Source release: https://registry.npmjs.org/skulpt/-/skulpt-1.2.0.tgz
  Project: https://github.com/skulpt/skulpt
  MIT license retained in `skulpt/LICENSE`.
  Python 3 mode is enabled explicitly. This is an educational Python implementation,
  not full CPython; package and syntax compatibility varies.
- JSZip 3.10.1: `jszip/jszip.min.js`.
  Project: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
  License retained in `jszip/LICENSE.markdown`. Used under its MIT option.
